author: BenjaminRS
body:
#### PR description:

A small PR to fix warnings from duplicate entries of `hls` in the build file, and updating the target and output of the test configuration to reflect the Spring24MC campaign used in CMSSW17.

#### PR validation:

Ran the following commands:
```
scram b distclean 
scram b -j 8
scram build code-checks 
scram build code-format
cmsRun L1Trigger/L1TTrackMatch/test/L1TrackObjectNtupleMaker_cfg.py
```
All passed successfully and produced the desired output.
title: [L1T] Small fixes to L1TTrackMatch (Phase-2)
